label: Travellers who find generative AI results helpful
question: Do travellers find AI answers useful for travel?
answer: 78% of travellers found generative AI results somewhat or very helpful, for planning and in destination alike.
sample: Phocuswright, Chat, Plan, Book: GenAI Goes Mainstream
methodology: Phocuswright, Chat, Plan, Book: GenAI Goes Mainstream, 2025. The figure covers both trip planning and in-destination use.
